# deltaV (deltaV Build)

> deltaV (also deltaV Build, Delta V, ΔV) is a five-engineer team that builds custom software, workflow automation and applied AI for businesses and individuals. Cost and timeline depend on complexity and the business case, and are set after a free scoping call. deltaV hosts and maintains what it builds on a monthly retainer; the client gets full use of the software and keeps its data.

## Name

- Δv (delta-v) is the astronautics measure of the impulse needed to change an object's trajectory. deltaV adds velocity to a business.
- deltaV (deltav.build) is not affiliated with Emerson's DeltaV process control system.

## Engagement

- Scope: free 30-minute call. Problem, payoff, plan.
- Build: working demos as it is built.
- Run: deltaV hosts, monitors and maintains it on its own infrastructure, on a monthly retainer.

## Services

- [Custom software](https://deltav.build/services/custom-software/): internal tools, dashboards, portals.
- [Workflow automation](https://deltav.build/services/workflow-automation/): system integration, task and approval flows, data pipelines.
- [Applied AI](https://deltav.build/services/applied-ai/): document retrieval, computer vision, classification, forecasting.

## FAQ

- [All questions](https://deltav.build/faq/): timeline and cost (set per project after a scoping call), hosting and maintenance, NDAs, data handling.
- [Live prototypes](https://deltav.build/work/): working demos by industry.
